Uttar Pradesh: Woman faces backlash for alleged remarks on CM Yogi Adityanath

Neha Bora, identified as the president of AISA (All India Students' Association), has drawn criticism in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, for allegedly making controversial remarks about Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Multiple police complaints (tahareer) were filed against her at three different police stations, with demands for her arrest and registration of an FIR. The specific content of Bora's alleged remarks and the context of the controversy are not detailed in the provided coverage.
